name: Pandora
description: To facilitate computer analysis of visual art, in the form of paintings, we introduce Pandora (Paintings Dataset for Recognizing the Art movement) database, a collection of digitized paintings labelled with respect to the artistic movement. Noting that the set of databases available as benchmarks for evaluation is highly reduced and most existing ones are limited in variability and number of images, we propose a novel large scale dataset of digital paintings. The database consists of more than 7700 images from 12 art movements. Each genre is illustrated by a number of images varying from 250 to nearly 1000. We investigate how local and global features and classification systems are able to recognize the art movement. reputation: A classic but relatively niche art-history vision dataset that has been used in early work on painting and art-movement recognition.
notes: Small-to-moderate sized vision benchmark with 12 classes; non-LLM and likely somewhat saturated, with performance sensitive to feature extraction and train/test splits.
